content: Claude Code billing leak: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var overrides Pro/Max/Team subscription and bills per-token even when logged into a subscription account. Confirmed by multiple GitHub issues (#12352, #43333, #37686, #44669, #39903, #53638, #45572, #62770) including cases with unintended charges of $150-$1800+. Subagent child processes inherit and use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY independently of parent auth mode (#39903). Official docs list additional billing/routing vars: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY, AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK, ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY/AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL/PROJECT_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX, apiKeyHelper setting. Credential precedence: cloud provider creds > ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN > ANTHROPIC_API_KEY > apiKeyHelper > OAuth token > /login subscription. settings.json env block values override shell-inherited env and apply regardless of launch method.
